svg.desc: 25 accurate Boys curves n=0..24, evaluated using confluent hypergeometric function. Equal physical x/y scales; integer ticks and actual LaTeX serif labels/formula. Uploaded Fira Code Light: F filled, height exactly 1.5 units with stem x=0 and baseline y=0; ABO outlined at exactly the n=0 curve stroke width 2.5pt. Letter coloring follows five Boys curve boundaries, reaching maximum lightening by the fifth lower band and constant thereafter. Adaptive polylines bound error at 1500px to 0.01px for n<=5 and 0.08px for n>5 before coordinate rounding. Natural-width overlapping ABO with full-silhouette masks excluding rear letters from counters. Axes rendered in foreground. High orders naturally converge near zero and are not displaced.
